messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Police cybercrime cell. Ek complaint aap ke number se offensive content post karne par aayi hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Maine kuch post nahi kiya, mera phone hack ho sakta hai!

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Charges hatane ke liye verification officer se milna hoga. Pehle 15,000 ka processing fee bhejo JazzCash par.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Mujhe station aa kar milna chahta hoon.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Station aaoge to seedha remand mein jao ge. Abhi turant fee bhejo aur case khatam karo.
